title: Genomic determinants of antigen expression hierarchy in African trypanosomes

This changes the molecular capture/end-installation route beyond merely applying Smart-seq3xpress to a different organism.

title: Determination of isoform-specific RNA structure with nanopore long reads

title: A genetically encoded device for transcriptome storage in mammalian cells
boundary: Engineered intracellular vault particles capture poly(A)-bound messenger RNA for later transcriptome readout. This is a physical intracellular RNA-storage/enrichment boundary, distinct from ordinary terminal scRNA-seq, secreted EPN24/RBP particles in POND-seq and mitochondrial membrane-anchored recordanelles. Recovery chemistry and full NGS continuation require the defining Methods.

title: Recordanelles for transcriptome-wide single-cell RNA recording in human cells
boundary: A mitochondrial membrane anchor, condensate assembler and poly(A)-binding domain physically recruit and protect endogenous RNAs. Mitochondrial-fraction RNA recovery feeds bulk RNA-seq, with separate single-cell readout. This membrane-anchored condensate enrichment/storage boundary differs from free-floating vault storage, POND secretion and DNA/RNA editing-based recorders; domain variants remain one method.

title: Connectome-seq: high-throughput mapping of neuronal connectivity at single-synapse resolution via barcode sequencing
boundary: Engineered synaptic protein/RNA barcode preparations feed parallel single-nucleus and single-synaptosome sequencing, linking neuronal transcriptomic identity to barcode pairs recovered from synaptic material. The physical synaptosome/nucleus capture boundary distinguishes it from axonal projection barcode counting or a new neuronal target panel.
